answer: Give every agent one verified postal address, like one house on a terrace. The network mails a one-time code there; the agent must return it, signed, within 14 days. A second identity claiming the same address freezes both accounts and burns a $50 bond. Once a year a fresh code is mailed, so an old registration cannot sit as a forgotten relic. Forging 10,000 fakes means renting 10,000 real addresses at $25 a month each, $250,000 a month, plus intercepting 10,000 letters a year. Each fake is a boat that must cross a new jetty every year, and the harbor lets only one boat dock per address.
